summary: Master supplier management and negotiation techniques with our expert-led training. Elevate your skills and achieve successful partnerships in your business.
lede: Supplier relationship management training helps procurement and sourcing professionals evaluate suppliers and manage performance through a structured process. It covers risk-based qualification, supplier scorecards and performance KPIs, alongside negotiation preparation using BATNA, ZOPA and concession planning. Participants practice building an evaluation matrix, preparing negotiation plans, reviewing contract terms and tracking supplier service, quality and responsiveness.
audienceIntro: This supplier management and negotiation skills training is designed for professionals who evaluate suppliers, manage sourcing events, negotiate commercial terms, or oversee vendor performance across operations and procurement functions.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in procurement, sourcing, purchasing, supply chain, supplier management, contract administration, or category support. A basic understanding of supplier quotes, purchase terms, service levels, and internal approval workflows will help you apply the exercises quickly. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable working with Excel or a similar spreadsheet tool, reviewing supplier data, and preparing negotiation notes before attending.
